k.q: Trace linear search for target 2 in an unsorted array.
k.code:
array values = [8,4,11,2,7]
target = 2
found = -1
for i=0 to 4
    if values[i] == target AND found == -1 then
        found = i
    endif
next i
print(found)
p: Change target to 11; predict the index.
Change target to 99 and predict the result.
k.a: Original target 2: index 3. Target 11: index 2. Target 99: -1, indicating no match. The loop checks all positions but preserves the first found index.
